clue.text: Graves suggesting appropriate farewell to 2016, to go by a death toll that's terrible

indicators.note: something terrible is in a dreadful state, so these letters are knocked into a new order

parts.words: to go by a death toll

explanation.surface: A year-end lament about the many famous deaths of 2016, saying their appalling toll merits a parting shot.
explanation.walkthrough: Robert Graves wrote a memoir of this title; the clue says it suits 2016, a year of many celebrity deaths.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the title of Robert Graves's autobiography, and as a phrase it is a fitting parting word for a bad year.

clue.text: Choirmaster set to adapt seasonal song

indicators.note: to adapt something is to alter it, so these letters are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A choir leader prepares to arrange a festive tune for the choir.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known carol sung at Christmas, so a song tied to one season of the year.

clue.text: Fernando Torres slightly to the right of the centre spot

explanation.surface: A football picture: the striker Fernando Torres standing just off the centre spot at kick-off.
explanation.walkthrough: Fernando Torres is a Spanish striker; his name has fourteen letters and the three wanted start at the seventh, just right of centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round mark is both a spot and a dot: plain synonyms.

clue.text: Nosh, for example: something served after home improvement's over

indicators.note: after says the served item follows the reversed piece
over says the letters for home improvement are turned round, as in a down light read upwards

parts.note: DIY, do-it-yourself, is home improvement done by the owner

explanation.surface: Food (nosh) is brought out once the DIY work on the house is finished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nosh' looks like food here, but it is offered as a word: it comes from this language.
explanation.definitionFit: The word nosh, meaning food or snack, was borrowed into English from this Jewish language, so it is an example of its vocabulary.

clue.text: Argentine marksman formerly in England taking part in uprising of Belize Veterans

taking part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'uprising' means read upwards. The marksman is a goalscorer: Carlos Tevez played for West Ham, Manchester United and Manchester City.
explanation.definitionFit: Carlos Tevez is an Argentine striker, a marksman in the scoring sense, who played in the English Premier League.

clue.text: They're using commercial detectives to surround court

indicators.note: to surround says the detectives' letters go round the court's

parts.note: DIs are Detective Inspectors

explanation.surface: An advert features police officers closing in on a court building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Using' is the drug-taking sense: people who are using are taking drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Addicts are habitual drug-takers, and 'using' is slang for taking drugs, so they are the ones using.

clue.text: Possibly runs hotline to find animal killers

indicators.note: possibly says these letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Someone may set up a telephone helpline to track down people who kill animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Hunters who shoot big cats are, quite literally, killers of a kind of animal.

clue.text: A certain form of dumbing-down in fancy editions I rewrite

indicators.note: to rewrite text is to recast it, so these letters are set down in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone complains about simplifying a story while revising some luxury editions.
explanation.definitionFit: Making something sanitised and simplistic in the manner of the Disney films is a particular kind of dumbing-down.

clue.text: Small fish smell

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

clue.text: The Virgin bearing Jesus, figuratively, could be monumental work

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' plays on Mary giving birth, but here it means holding inside.

clue.text: Scooter boy in the war department

the ..., Ministry of Defence, is the British government department for the armed forces

clue.text: Gathered American fool's heartlessly elected

clue.text: British clubs essentially supporting Blatter, which is suicide

clue.text: Inspiration to include diameter in measurement
